### Our Need of Peace and Holiness
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/our-need-of-peace-and-holiness
Passage: Hebrews 12:14
Points:
- Running the Christian race well requires actively pursuing both peace with others and personal holiness.
- Believers are called to be peacemakers because Christ came to restore relational harmony lost in the Fall.
- True peace must be built on truth and should never compromise God's word to avoid conflict.
- Holiness is essential for entering the presence of a God who cannot tolerate sin.
- Sanctification is a progressive journey of putting sin to death while resting in Christ as our righteousness.
